STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Monthly TDS / TCS Payment Deposit
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Statutory remittance of withholding tax deducted in the preceding month via Challan ITNS 281.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Mandatory interest under Sec 201(1A) @ 1.5% per month from deduction date until actual payment.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: GSTR-1 Monthly Return Filing
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.targetAssessee: Regular Registered GST Dealers (Turnover > ₹5 Cr or Non-QRMP)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Reporting outward supplies of goods and services to ensure Input Tax Credit (ITC) populates into buyer's GSTR-2B.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Late fee up to ₹50/day (₹20/day for Nil) under Sec 47; blocks GSTR-3B submission.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: GSTR-1 IFF (Invoice Furnishing Facility)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Optional upload of B2B outward invoices for Month 1 and Month 2 of the quarter to pass ITC to buyers.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Inability of buyers to claim provisional ITC in their respective GSTR-2B cycles.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: EPF ECR Challan & ESIC Contribution Remittance
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Monthly deposit of 24% EPF (Employee + Employer) and 4% ESIC statutory labor payroll contributions.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Strict penal damages under Section 14B (up to 25% p.a.) plus interest under Section 7Q.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Advance Tax Installment (15% Cumulative)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.targetAssessee: All Assessees with Net Tax Liability exceeding ₹10,000
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: First mandatory installment representing at least 15% of estimated total annual income tax liability.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Mandatory penal interest under Section 234C @ 1% per month for deferment of installment.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Advance Tax Installment (45% Cumulative)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.targetAssessee: Corporate, Firms, HNIs & Salaried with Non-Salary Incomes
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Second installment bringing total advance tax payment to at least 45% of total tax liability.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Section 234C interest penalty computed on the shortfall amount.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Advance Tax Installment (75% Cumulative)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.targetAssessee: All Assessees with Net Tax Liability exceeding ₹10,000
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Third installment requiring cumulative remittance of at least 75% of total estimated tax.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Compounded interest under Section 234C and Section 234B on short payment.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Advance Tax Installment (100% Cumulative)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Final installment bringing total advance tax payment to 100% of final liability before financial year close.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Accumulated interest under Section 234B & 234C applied until return filing date.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: GSTR-3B Summary Return & Tax Settlement
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Final settlement of output tax liability through electronic cash/credit ledger after rigorous GSTR-2B ITC matching.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Late fee up to ₹50/day + statutory interest under Section 50 @ 18% p.a. on net tax paid in cash.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: West Bengal Professional Tax (P-Tax Return & Deposit)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.act: WB State Tax on Professions Act, 1979
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.targetAssessee: Employers, Business Entities & Enrolled Professionals in WB
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Monthly deposit of deducted P-Tax from employee salaries via GRIPS and annual Form III filing.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Penal interest @ 1% per month and penalty up to 100% of tax default amount under Section 7.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Quarterly e-TDS Return Filing (24Q, 26Q, 27Q)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Submission of statement of tax deducted at source enabling TRACES Form 16 / 16A generation and 26AS/AIS credit.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Mandatory late fee of ₹200 per day under Section 234E until filing, plus penalty under Section 271H.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Income Tax Return (ITR-1 through 4) Non-Audit
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Statutory annual filing of direct tax returns for all non-audit entities for the preceding financial year.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Late filing fee under Section 234F (up to ₹5,000), forfeiture of loss carry-forward, and 234A interest.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Tax Audit Report (Form 3CA/3CB-3CD)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Mandatory audit report signed by Chartered Accountant evaluating true financial positions and statutory disallowances.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Severe penalty under Section 271B equal to 0.5% of total sales/turnover (maximum ₹1.5 Lakh).

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Income Tax Return (Corporate & Audited Assessees)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.targetAssessee: Companies, Audited Firms & Working Partners of Audited Entities
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Final e-filing of audited income tax returns and finalized statutory balance sheets with IT Department.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Section 234A interest, loss carry-forward disallowance, and scrutiny initiation.

STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.title: Annual GST Return (GSTR-9) & Reconciliation (GSTR-9C)
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.targetAssessee: GSTR-9: Turnover > ₹2 Cr | GSTR-9C: Turnover > ₹5 Cr
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.importance: Comprehensive annual audit reconciling financial balance sheets, turnover, output tax, and input tax credit.
STATUTORY_DUE_DATES.consequence: Late fee of ₹200/day (subject to turnover caps) and departmental audit scrutiny summons.
